review.working_tree_note: Pre-existing untracked .serena/ observed and left untouched. No repository files modified. No generator/build, article code, PoC, HTML, attachment, scanner, or external target executed/accessed.

mapping_checks.virtual_categories: All 15 explicit index_category values appear in the 5570 record entries; wiki-catalog.js uses those values to place navigation while preserving each Markdown route.

evidence.schema: docs/CONTENT-SCHEMA.md defines archive_url as an optional historical archive URL distinct from source_url and states it does not replace or verify source_url.
evidence.generator: scripts/wiki.py catalog_record() does not copy archive_url, archive_commit, or archive_title into sources.jsonl.
evidence.consumer: scripts/wiki.py search --include-sources searches the serialized sources.jsonl object, so these retained archive values cannot be found through this query entrance.

confirmed_projection_defects.impact: Archive provenance is present in source Markdown but absent from generated source records and metadata search; consumers of the projection cannot recover it without reopening the article.
confirmed_projection_defects.suggested_correction: Copy archive_url verbatim as a distinct source-record field and project archive_commit/archive_title when present; keep archive_url separate from source.url. Add a read-only fixture/assertion that a source record and --include-sources query retain and match the exact archive URL, commit and title.

evidence.candidate_definition: Read-only extraction matching the generator's source_url/ref/verification_source and labelled-reference URL collection, before its 50-item slice.

confirmed_projection_defects.impact: Source-record links silently omit the later extracted URL values in these six records. The original article remains intact, but generated projection/search cannot retrieve those links, contrary to the repository rule that derived source URLs are not truncated or hidden.
confirmed_projection_defects.suggested_correction: Remove the fixed [:50] truncation or replace it only with a documented, non-lossy projection strategy. Retain each exact URL string and deterministic order/deduplication. Add a focused fixture with over 50 distinct labelled URLs and verify the last URL survives generation and --include-sources search.

not_found_in_checked_projection: No mismatch between any of the 5570 record rows and its primary source row for the compared entry metadata fields.
No missing, duplicate, or mis-canonicalized source_record_ids across the 5664 indexed sources and 5570 primary entries.
No count discrepancy in the stated 94 duplicate_of-folded records or the two excluded records.
No detected role-bucket collapse among explicit primary_identifiers, identifier_candidates, and referenced_identifiers.
No missing index_category value among the 15 overrides in records.jsonl; the catalog consumer applies those as virtual navigation paths.
unknowns_and_limits: This audit checks projection integrity, not the truth of each article's primary/candidate/reference assignment, duplicate equivalence, archive/source authenticity, technical content, or vulnerability status.
duplicate-candidates.json intentionally lists shared-primary groups for manual review; 476 candidate groups are not a count of confirmed duplicates.
The generated index page contents were inspected as derived navigation, but no browser interaction/rendered UI was exercised.
The six URL counts represent values extractable under the generator's current labelled-reference rules; they do not claim every URL in article bodies is a provenance link.
